replication_intent.stated_purpose: Create additional workers to reduce task processing delays.

evaluated_alternatives.rationale: Leaving the current workload distribution unchanged would not resolve the observed latency deficit.
Existing idle workers have sufficient capacity to absorb queued tasks without creating additional instances.
Additional workers could reduce processing delays, but replication is unnecessary because redistribution achieves the required service level.

meaning_conversion.rationale: The observed latency deficit is caused by uneven workload distribution rather than insufficient total processing capacity. Existing workers can resolve the deficit through workload redistribution without replication.
